calibrated.why: no override: the lens holds today's multiple on the model's own EPS (price / 2027 operating EPS after business development), as the rule defines it. The first version held 24x and called it the five-year low of the forward multiple; that low (23.1x) is on conventional EPS and is a hindsight figure, so 24x on the model's EPS was about 20-21x conventional, under anything paid in five years. The held multiple is 1.7x the base exit multiple: the model flags it, and the lens is not an independent second opinion here (the two lenses differ only by the multiple)

exit_pe.reason_if_different: the own median (38.7x on conventional EPS, a hindsight series of the five years in which EPS grew 46-105% a year = 45.2x on the model's 2032 EPS after business development) is not used: in the exit years the base grows revenue 1-4% and operating EPS about 0-2% a year; tirzepatide (56% of 2032 base revenue) loses its US compound patent in 2036, with generic filings made in 2026 (10-Q Note 9); US generic semaglutide is possible from 2032 (Novo Nordisk 20-F); direct peers trade at a median 17.6x forward today (NVO 12.4, AZN 16.6, MRK 17.6, ABBV 18.8, AMGN 19.2; stockanalysis.com, not re-verified). 20x on the model's EPS is about 17.1x conventional EPS in 2032 (before interest). The literal rule is a variant line and does not change the verdict

notes.margin: operating margin after stock compensation and after recurring business development: performance margin (gross margin - R&D - MS&A, non-GAAP; SBC is inside; guide 52.0-52.5% for 2026, 51.2% after removing the one-time revenue) less 0.7pt recurring special charges (2024 861, 2025 484, 9M26 1,285) less business development as a cost ($9.0-9.8B a year in the base = 8.5% of revenue falling to 6.5%; history: IPR&D purchases + acquisitions 5.0B in 2023, 4.3B in 2024, 3.7B in 2025, 18.2B in 9M 2026; Lilly itself keeps acquired IPR&D inside non-GAAP EPS). Amortization of acquired intangibles (~0.5B) is left out because the purchase cash is already counted. Base performance margin 53.0% in 2027 (consensus-implied ~54.6%), 53.5%, 53.0%, 53.0%, 52.0%, 51.0%: price erosion and the depreciation wave (depreciation 1.8% of revenue in 2026 to 3.6% in 2032) against MS&A leverage; the Jardiance collaboration share (near-100% margin) ends after 2028

notes.pe: exit multiple on next-year operating EPS AFTER business development. Locked rule = own long-run forward P/E median: 38.7x over Nov 2021-Oct 2026, 34.7x since 2023 (deep/multiple_history.py, hindsight series). NOT used, stated facts: (1) that median was paid for EPS growing +105% (2024), +86% (2025), +46% (2026), +43% (2027 consensus); in the exit years the base path grows operating EPS about 0-2% a year; (2) tirzepatide, ~56% of 2032 base revenue, loses US compound-patent protection in 2036 (10-K) and generic ANDAs were filed in 2026 (10-Q Note 9); (3) direct peers today: NVO 12.4x, AZN 16.6x, MRK 17.6x, ABBV 18.8x, AMGN 19.2x forward (stockanalysis.com statistics pages, 2026-11-15), median 17.6x. Base 20x on after-BD operating EPS (= 17.1x on a conventional EPS before future business development and special charges in 2032, before interest; the direct-peer median today is 17.6x); bull 28x (24.8x conventional); bear 14x (10.8x conventional, about Novo Nordisk today). The conversion uses the 2032 ratio of conventional to model EPS (1.168; in 2027 it is 1.211, and consensus / model is 1.226). The locked-rule multiple on that basis is 45.2x: a variant line
notes.patent_cliff: the model's fade years (2033-2041) grow NOPAT from the 2032 rate up to rf and cannot show the 2036 US / 2037 EU tirzepatide loss of exclusivity. It is put in as a charge in 2032 (index 5) = present value at 2032 of losing 15% (base), 8% (bull), 20% (bear) of the model's own after-tax path from 2038 on, phased over 2036-2038 (deep/build_params.py cliff_charge). The charge enters the DCF; the exit-multiple method carries the cliff in the multiple
notes.bear: company-specific: net price falls faster than volume grows (price -13% to -15% a year in 2026 per releases; Medicare coverage at government prices; more entrants: Novo oral and CagriSema, Pfizer monthly from 2028), tirzepatide flat at 66-69B then down to 59B; successors slower; performance margin 50% falling to 44%; business development stays at 9B; charges after tax: 4,000 in 2028 for inventory (18.2B, +32% in 9M) and take-or-pay supply commitments (up to ~10B, 10-K), 2,000 in 2029 for litigation (product-liability MDLs, pricing, 340B; self-insured). A harsher tail (tirzepatide down to 51B by 2032, margin to 41%) is worth about $250 and is not in the table
notes.bull: the guidance-beat record: first revenue guide beaten by about +11% (2023; the guide from a secondary source), +9.9% (2024: 45.04B against a 41.0B midpoint), +9.5% (2025: 65.18B against 59.5B) and the 2026 guide raised +12.3% in three steps (releases); bull 2027 revenue 111.5B = +4.7% above consensus 106.5B (analyst high 114.3B); incretin franchise 145.5B in 2030 (124.5B in 2029), which is close to the whole 2030 market in the published forecasts found (TD Cowen about 150B, via an aggregator; not read in the original); performance margin to 57%
notes.probabilities: subjective judgement, not engine odds: bear 25%, base 55%, bull 20% (first version 25/50/25; the bull needs a 2030 incretin market far above the published forecasts found, and its 2030 revenue is about 35% above the 2030 consensus while the bear is about 22% below)
notes.base_review: review of 15.11.2026: (1) US generic semaglutide: Novo Nordisk's 20-F (FY2023) gives 2032 as the US patent expiry of Ozempic, Rybelsus and Wegovy; secondary sources differ between December 2031 and December 2032 and later patents may delay entry. Base tirzepatide 2032 lowered from 86B to 83B (about half a year of a 7% first-year effect; judgement). The bear (59B) and the bull are unchanged. (2) The base far years are at or above the published long-range numbers found (2030 consensus revenue about 132B, TIKR 02.10.2026, before the Q3 raise; base 140.7B): the gap to the analysts is the multiple and the deal cost, not revenue. (3) Base 2027 revenue 105.4B is at about consensus (106.5B) and below the company's beat record; the beat record is in the bull. (4) The Medicare GLP-1 Bridge ends 31.12.2027 (10-Q) with no agreed successor: a named falsifier, no input change
